newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mainly higher with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mainly higher with crude.

text.p: NWE oil products were generally firmer, taking their lead from crude.
Gasoline fluctuated with futures. U.S. arbitrage business in the past two days has removed 150,000 tonnes from Europe. Naphtha also ebbed and flowed with crude. Two cargoes were awarded in tenders.
Gas oil was firm. The heating oil barge market was busy with strong demand from Germany.
High sulphur cracked barges pumped to new highs of $118 fob ARA before slipping back. The low sulphur market was very quiet and only supported by high sulphur.
